query:
SELECT
                pk_systems.uuid,
                pk_systems.id,
                pk_systems.name,
                pk_systems.avatar,
                pk_systems.created_at,
                pk_systems.updated_at
            FROM
                pk_systems
            WHERE (
                pk_systems.updated_at <= NOW() - interval '24 hours'
            ) AND (
                    uuid IN (
                        SELECT
                            system_uuid
                        FROM
                            pk_notify_systems
                        INNER JOIN
                            guilds
                        ON
                            guilds.guild_id = pk_notify_systems.guild_id
                        WHERE
                            guilds.deleted_at IS NULL
                    )
                OR
                    uuid IN (
                        SELECT
                            system_uuid
                        FROM
                            pk_guilds
                        INNER JOIN
                            pk_fronters
                        ON
                            pk_guilds.guild_id = pk_fronters.guild_id
                        INNER JOIN
                            guilds
                        ON
                            pk_guilds.guild_id = guilds.guild_id
                        WHERE
                            guilds.deleted_at IS NULL
                    )
            )
            ORDER BY
                updated_at
            ASC
            LIMIT 5
